user.title: Choose a service and features
user.description: Select a service and the voice features to enable. Enter connection details on the next screen.

connection.title: Enter connection details
connection.description: Enter connection details for the selected service and features. A blank API key keeps the saved key only for the same provider and URL. Enter a new key when switching services. Disable discovery to enter model and voice IDs manually.

data_description.stt_models_url: Full GET catalog URL. Leave blank to enter this model ID manually. Both catalogs may use the same URL. This is not the audio inference endpoint.
data_description.stt_models_api_key: Bearer key. When blank, reuse the speech key only on the same scheme, host and port; other origins receive no key.
data_description.tts_models_url: Full GET catalog URL. Leave blank to enter this model ID manually. Both catalogs may use the same URL. This is not the audio inference endpoint.
data_description.tts_models_api_key: Bearer key. When blank, reuse the speech key only on the same scheme, host and port; other origins receive no key.
data_description.stt_url: Full POST URL. Blank uses the base URL plus /audio/transcriptions. The payload and response must remain OpenAI-compatible.
data_description.stt_api_key: Bearer key for this endpoint. Without a separate key, reuse the shared key only on the same scheme, host and port.
data_description.tts_url: Full POST URL. Blank uses the base URL plus /audio/speech. The payload and response must remain OpenAI-compatible.
data_description.tts_api_key: Bearer key for this endpoint. Without a separate key, reuse the shared key only on the same scheme, host and port.
data_description.tts_streaming: Off by default. Stream generated audio after receiving the complete text. Verify playback with your voice and speaker.

model.title: Choose an STT model
model.description: Choose the transcription language in your Assist pipeline.

tts.title: Choose a TTS model
tts.description: Choose a model supporting WAV for Gemini or MP3 for other services.

voice.title: Choose a voice
voice.description: OpenRouter, xAI and Gemini show fetched voices; OpenAI shows documented built-in voices. Enter an ID if discovery is disabled or your voice is missing.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP(S) API root or endpoint URL.
error.invalid_auth: The service rejected the API key.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to fetch models. Retry or disable discovery.
error.invalid_config: Check the connection settings and API key format.
